description_en: Queries the parameters that are used to import key material for a customer master key (CMK)
description_zh: 获取导入主密钥材料的参数
kebab_example: aliyun kms get-parameters-for-import --key-id 202b9877-5a25-46e3-a763-e20791b50000 --wrapping-algorithm RSAES_PKCS1_V1_5 --wrapping-key-spec RSA_2048 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetParametersForImport

parameters.help_en:
The globally unique ID of the CMK.

>  You can import key material only for CMKs whose Origin parameter is set to EXTERNAL
parameters.help_zh:
主密钥的全局唯一标识符。

> 密钥材料来源必须是外部，即Origin为EXTERNAL。
parameters.name: key_id

parameters.help_en: The algorithm that is used to encrypt key material

parameters.name: wrapping_algorithm
